procedure.method: Independent review of only the explicitly pinned inputs in this fresh session, with no peer/producer/planner records followed, no spawning/forking/resume, and no image generation or edits. Verified all listed byte/hash pins. Read the source manifest (product reference; no protected poster layout) and all five pinned native-evidence manifests without following their unlisted paths. Opened the exact source PNG through tools.view_image(detail=original), then actually viewed the 15 exact poster PNGs through tools.view_image(detail=original), one at a time in packet order M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2, M3, M4, M5 in the same three-view order. All 15 returned visible images before the first text-reading/transcription or judgment/score stage. Initial readings were taken from the visible native posters and cross-scale readings assessed against usage and thumbnail views; supplied copy was not used to fill omitted text. After the first readings, reopened only M2 native and M4 native once each for genuine day-range spacing ambiguities; both remain unresolved. No tool-event or runtime session identity is invented. Source fidelity below is a visual comparison, not proof of actual source inclusion in a native generator call. Native dimensions are 1672×941 (M1/M2/M4/M5) or 1672×940 (M3), not mathematically exact 16:9; both heights are 0.5 pixel from 1672×9/16=940.5 and pass the predeclared nearest-integer-single-edge policy. Usage is 720×405 and thumbnail 320×180.
